checks.call_identity: Wrapped calls preserve receiver syntax or explicit .call(input); references/arguments/order remain original. Existing revalidation and freshness observations remain in place.
checks.compare_signature: Exported compareScenarios delegates through Parameters/ReturnType of the original async implementation; argument and promise result types remain. No producer fallback, retry or response transformation is added.
checks.exceptions: Timing helper returns original result and rethrows the same caught error. HTTP retains existing catch/finally and human.finish.
checks.transport_and_budgets: No Request/body/signal construction, fixture, spec, assertion, timeout, workflow or selection change. Only four source paths are instrumented.
checks.logging: Constants, per-module counters, performance times and existing result status only. No payload, identifiers, source refs, headers, cookies, tokens, authority fields, projection values or error details are logged.
checks.type_narrowing: The currency as USD cast remains inside the preexisting currency===USD branch; it restores the narrowing across a newly introduced logging closure and has no runtime effect.
checks.blob_validation: All four pre/post Git blob identities verified textually against full material.

measurement_limits: Temporary instrumentation adds console I/O and promise/microtask overhead; timings are diagnostic and cannot qualify production latency.

No C08 clone or canonical hashing primitive is instrumented here; any attribution inside an observed reader phase remains inference until exact lower-level evidence exists.
